Ivy: FYI - Northbridge Bio has a security review at 10am tomorrow. They want: RBAC change logs with a justification field, KMS/HSM attestation for their private pilot, Splunk HEC sample with cert fingerprint, and a short note on CVE-2026-1234 impact. Can we assemble a 1-page packet + evidence bundle?
Rohan: I can export RBAC changes for service accounts (last 90 days). Will include `justification` and `change_ticket` fields.
Marta: For HSM attestation, private customers require ops to run attestation locally. We can provide a redacted signed blob example and an outline of the attestation contents. Ops: can you schedule a run?
ops-bot: Attestation job queued: attestation_request_1791234567. Assigned to eng-oncall.
Rohan: Export CLI: `redwoodctl audit export --tenant northbridge --filter rbac,service_accounts --from 2026-03-01 --to 2026-06-30 --fields ts,actor,action,role,justification,change_ticket,request_id --format ndjson`
Rohan: sample line (redacted): `{"ts":"2026-05-11T12:03:22Z","actor":"svc-deploy-nb","action":"grant-role","role":"inference-worker","justification":"enable batch job (TICKET-128) ","change_ticket":"TICKET-128","request_id":"req_a12"}`
Marta: HSM sample note: attestation contains firmware version, vendor cert chain, PCR values, and signed timestamp. We will include `attestation_sample.pdf.redacted`.
Ivy: Splunk: need the SHA256 fingerprint and example event envelope. Rohan - can you add that to the bundle?
Rohan: Splunk config snippet and fingerprint (redacted): `cert_fingerprint=sha256:aa:bb:...:ff`. Event shape: `{"time":1654056723,"host":"redwood-01","event":{"source":"redwood.audit","type":"rbac_change","details":{...}}}`
Marta: CVE status: fastloader CVE-2026-1234 patched in hosted (v1.2.3). For private/dedicated we provide patched images + upgrade playbook. We'll attach `cve-2026-1234-triage.md`.
Ivy: Action items: Rohan - export + Splunk (ETA 2h); Marta - attestation placeholder + CVE note (ETA 4h); I'll draft 1-pager and run a 15m dry-run before the call.
Rohan: Dropping bundle to /evidence/northbridge/bundle_1791234567.tar.gz when ready. Will sanitize IPs.
ops-bot: Attestation completed: attestation_1791234567.p7b (redacted) stored in /evidence/northbridge/
Ivy: Excellent. Dry-run at 9:30. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
